# Kohlrabi

Kohlrabi is a free workout tracker by Cruciferous Greens: log every set, build flexible programs, and share workouts. No subscription, no account wall, works offline.

## Key pages

- [Kohlrabi - Free workout tracker](https://getkohlrabi.com/)
- [Example workouts](https://getkohlrabi.com/examples)
- [Features](https://getkohlrabi.com/features)
- [Getting started](https://getkohlrabi.com/getting-started)
- [Switch from another app](https://getkohlrabi.com/switch)
- [For trainers](https://getkohlrabi.com/trainers)
- [Beta](https://getkohlrabi.com/beta)
- [Release notes](https://getkohlrabi.com/release-notes)
- [Glossary](https://getkohlrabi.com/glossary)
- [Credits](https://getkohlrabi.com/credits)
- [Pitch in](https://getkohlrabi.com/pitch-in)
- [AI disclosure](https://getkohlrabi.com/ai-disclosure)
- [Privacy policy](https://getkohlrabi.com/privacy)
- [Terms and conditions](https://getkohlrabi.com/terms)

## Notes

- Sitemap index: https://getkohlrabi.com/sitemap.xml (pages, workouts, and programs each have their own sitemap).
- /workout and /program are generic resolvers, not canonical pages; always link the /workouts/<slug>.html or /programs/<slug>.html form.
- The app itself lives at https://kohlrabi.us and requires JavaScript; the marketing pages above are static HTML.
- Coaching and the blog live at https://cruciferousgreens.com (separate site).
